# What this does

Script 04's byssal tables showed that, in every arm, a few animals express the foot proteins
strongly and the rest barely do. This script asks, within each arm (so that no treatment
effect enters): is that one state of the animal, shared across the byssal genes, or gene by gene?
Which mussels are high for most mussel foot proteins (mfp)? Do the same animals stand out in the
other byssal gene groups, and does the state go with library size, thread production or thread
strength? And it draws script 04's genes as heatmaps with the animals in a fixed order, so that
one mussel can be followed across gene groups.

**Gene groups.** Script 04's categories, with its byssal structural genes split three ways by
protein name: **mfp-1 to -6** (the classical *Mytilus* foot proteins: adhesive plaque matrix
protein / foot protein 1, foot proteins 2 to 6, mefp-5), **thread core** (precollagens D, P and
NG, thread matrix proteins) and **other byssal structural** (foot proteins 9 to 17, YGH-rich
proteins, byssal EP-like protein, byssal protein-1). Statistics use the genes that pass script
04's expression filter (count above 5 in a third of the animals); the heatmaps also show the mfp
genes below it, marked `+`, and mark hits below 40% identity `*`.

**Expression.** Script 04's variance-stabilised counts (`DESeq2::vst(blind = TRUE)` over every
library of the tissue except the rest-of-foot libraries; recomputed here, and a check confirms
they are script 04's), so that the day-0 lab control can be shown beside the arms. For each
gene and arm, an animal's value is turned into a z-score within its arm; a group's **score** for
an animal is the mean of those z-scores over the group's genes (within-arm SD units, 0 = the
arm's average animal). The lab control enters only as a reference (its mean mfp expression); it
is not a control anywhere (its feet were dissected differently).

**Tests**, all within arms:

- *coordination*: the mean pairwise correlation of a group's genes across the animals of the
  same arm, against `nperm` permutations that shuffle each gene's values among the animals of
  each arm separately (each gene keeps its distribution, the alignment across genes within an
  animal is broken); p = (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + nperm);
- *mfp-high animals*: an animal is high for an mfp gene when it is in the top third of its arm
  for that gene, and mfp-high when that holds for most of the expressed mfp genes (more than
  half); the number of mfp-high animals, and of animals high for every mfp gene, against the
  same permutations. The top third holds about four animals of every arm for every gene, so the
  number per arm is set by the rule; what the test asks is whether the same animals are on top
  for most genes;
- *which animals express the mfp genes*: mean mfp expression is either near the floor of the
  transform or far above it, so a two-component normal mixture with a common SD is fitted to the
  animals' mean mfp VST, pooled over arms (EM; Dempster, Laird and Rubin 1977, *J R Stat Soc B*
  39:1-38), and compared with a single normal by BIC (Schwarz 1978, *Ann Stat* 6:461-464; a
  difference above 10 is very strong evidence, Kass and Raftery 1995, *J Am Stat Assoc*
  90:773-795). An animal expresses the mfp genes ("mfp-on") when its posterior for the upper
  component is above 0.5; whether the share of such animals differs between arms is a Fisher
  exact test;
- *what the state goes with*: the Spearman correlations of the group scores with each other, and
  of the mfp score with library size and the number of genes detected; the mfp score against
  threads made during the exposure (`log(1 + threads) ~ score + arm`, from
  `01_mussel-measurements/mussel-thread-production.xlsx`) and against day-3 mean peak force and
  plaque area adjusted for the animal's baseline (script 01's ANCOVA,
  `log(day 3) ~ score + arm + log(baseline)`). Exploratory: three tests, raw p. And one technical
  check: the RNA yield of the animal's isolation (`log(yield) ~ score + arm`; `05`'s crosswalk to the
  isolation log), the only record of how much tissue the dissected piece held;
- *beyond the byssal genes*: every other gene against the mfp score within arms
  (`VST ~ score + arm`, nuclear genes with at least 10 counts in a third of the animals, the filter
  of the DEG fits; the expressed mfp genes, which make the score, left out), with BH q over genes.
  It shows how far the state reaches: whether the mfp-high animals express more of everything or
  a particular set of genes. Expression here is relative (each library is scaled to the others by
  DESeq2's size factors), so a rise in the total mRNA of an animal cannot be seen; a program that
  takes a larger share of the reads pushes the other genes down a little.

The mfp tests need at least 3 expressed mfp genes (in gill only one passes the filter, so they
are skipped there and the heatmaps are ordered by the byssal structural genes instead).

**What the state is not, and what it may be.** The foot libraries are the phenol gland to the tip
of the foot, cut by hand. An animal whose piece held more of the glands that make the plaque and
cuticle proteins would show every one of those genes higher, the pattern tested here; RNA yield is
a coarse check on the size of the piece, not on its make-up, so a difference in dissection cannot
be ruled out. Tamarin, Lewis and Askey (1976, *J Morphol* 149:199-221) describe the glands that
open into the distal depression of the foot and form the plaque; Waite (2017, *J Exp Biol*
220:517-530) reviews how the foot makes the plaque and thread.

Writes, in `03_analyses/byssus_individuals/`: `byssal_animals_<T>.csv`, `byssal_coordination_<T>.csv`,
`byssal_group_correlations_<T>.csv`, `byssal_mfp_tests_<T>.csv`, `byssal_mfp_genome_<T>.csv` and
`byssal_mfp_genome_<T>.png` (foot only), four heatmaps
(`byssal_heatmap_<structural|all>_<by_mfp|by_id>_<T>.png`), `byssal_individuals_<T>.png` and
`RUN_provenance_<T>.txt`.

```{r inputs}
find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {

    d <- dirname(d)

}
repo_root <- find_repo_root()
source(file.path(repo_root, "tools", "pipeline_checks.R"))   # warn_unless(), provenance
```

# Expression and gene groups

```{r expression}
## script 04's transform, recomputed so that the lab-control libraries are available
cm <- read.csv(f_in[["counts"]], row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
ti <- read.csv(f_in[["ti"]], row.names = 1, colClasses = "character")
tcols <- grep(if (TISSUE == "F") "F$" else "G$", colnames(cm), value = TRUE)   # "F$" leaves out the rest-of-foot (FX) libraries
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(as.matrix(cm[, tcols])), DataFrame(row.names = tcols), design = ~ 1)
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 0, ]
V <- assay(vst(dds, blind = TRUE)); rownames(V) <- gene_key(rownames(V))
d04 <- max(abs(as.matrix(byss[, samp]) - V[byss$LOC_ID, samp]))
warn_unless(d04 < 6e-4, "The recomputed VST differs from script 04's table (largest difference ", signif(d04, 3), ").")
lc <- intersect(rownames(ti)[ti$day == "0" & ti$tissue == TISSUE & ti$region != "foot (without phenol gland)"], colnames(V))
lib_size <- colSums(cm[, tcols]); detected <- colSums(cm[, tcols] > 0)

## gene groups: script 04's categories, its byssal structural genes split by protein name
MFP_RX  <- "foot protein[- ]?[1-6](?![0-9])|adhesive plaque matrix|polyphenolic|\\bmefp"
CORE_RX <- "precollagen|\\bpreCol|nongradient byssal|thread matrix protein"
GROUPS <- c(mfp = "mfp-1 to -6", core = "Thread core", other = "Other byssal structural",
            byssal_accessory = "Byssal accessory", crosslink_curing = "Cross-linking and curing",
            collagen = "Collagen", collagen_biosynth = "Collagen biosynthesis", ecm_adhesion = "ECM and adhesion")
byss <- byss %>% mutate(
  group = case_when(category == "byssal_structural" & grepl(MFP_RX, protein_name, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE) ~ "mfp",
                    category == "byssal_structural" & grepl(CORE_RX, protein_name, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE) ~ "core",
                    category == "byssal_structural" ~ "other",
                    TRUE ~ category),
  label = paste0(short_name(protein_name, 30), " (", sub("^LOC134", "", LOC_ID), ")",
                 ifelse(!expressed, " +", ""), ifelse(!is.na(hi_conf) & !hi_conf, " *", "")))
stopifnot(all(byss$group %in% names(GROUPS)))
warn_unless(all(byss$mfp[byss$group == "mfp"]), "A gene of the mfp-1 to -6 group is not one of script 04's mfp genes.")
knitr::kable(byss %>% count(group = GROUPS[group], expressed) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = expressed, values_from = n, values_fill = 0,
                                                                              names_prefix = "expressed_"))
```

# Is the byssal state one state of the animal?

```{r scores}
## within-arm z-scores of every gene; a group's score is their mean over its expressed genes
Vd <- V[byss$LOC_ID, samp, drop = FALSE]
within_z <- function(x) { for (a in levels(arm)) { i <- which(arm == a); s <- sd(x[i]); x[i] <- if (s > 0) (x[i] - mean(x[i])) / s else 0 }; x }
Z <- t(apply(Vd, 1, within_z)); dimnames(Z) <- dimnames(Vd)
genes_of <- function(g) byss$LOC_ID[byss$group == g & byss$expressed]
scored <- names(GROUPS)[vapply(names(GROUPS), function(g) length(genes_of(g)) >= 3, TRUE)]
scores <- sapply(scored, function(g) colMeans(Z[genes_of(g), , drop = FALSE]))
mfp_genes <- genes_of("mfp"); K <- length(mfp_genes); HAS_MFP <- K >= 3
cat("groups scored (>= 3 expressed genes):", paste(GROUPS[scored], collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("expressed mfp genes:", K, if (!HAS_MFP) "- the mfp tests are skipped", "\n")

## the permutation: each gene's values shuffled among the animals of each arm, separately
idx_by_arm <- split(seq_along(arm), arm)
permute_rows <- function(M) { for (i in idx_by_arm) M[, i] <- t(apply(M[, i, drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) x[sample.int(length(x))])); M }
mean_r <- function(M) { C <- cor(t(M)); mean(C[upper.tri(C)]) }
set.seed(SEED)
coord <- bind_rows(lapply(scored, function(g) {
  M <- Z[genes_of(g), , drop = FALSE]; obs <- mean_r(M)
  null <- replicate(NPERM, mean_r(permute_rows(M)))
  tibble(group = GROUPS[[g]], genes = nrow(M), mean_r = obs, null_median = median(null),
         null_95 = unname(quantile(null, 0.95)), p = (1 + sum(null >= obs)) / (1 + NPERM))
}))
warn_unless(all(abs(coord$null_median) < 0.05), "A permutation null of the coordination test is not centred near 0.")
knitr::kable(coord %>% mutate(across(c(mean_r, null_median, null_95), ~ round(.x, 3))))
```

# Which mussels are high for most mfp genes?

```{r mfp-high}
high_of <- function(M) {                        # TRUE where an animal is in its arm's top third for a gene
  H <- matrix(FALSE, nrow(M), ncol(M))
  for (i in idx_by_arm) H[, i] <- t(apply(M[, i, drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) rank(x, ties.method = "average") > 2/3 * length(x)))
  H
}
if (HAS_MFP) {
  THR <- floor(K / 2) + 1                       # most: more than half of the expressed mfp genes
  n_high <- colSums(high_of(Vd[mfp_genes, , drop = FALSE]))
  set.seed(SEED + 1)
  null_n <- replicate(NPERM, { n <- colSums(high_of(permute_rows(Vd[mfp_genes, , drop = FALSE]))); c(most = sum(n >= THR), all = sum(n == K)) })
  high_test <- tibble(test = c(sprintf("animals in their arm's top third for >= %d of %d expressed mfp genes", THR, K),
                               sprintf("animals in their arm's top third for all %d expressed mfp genes", K)),
                      observed = c(sum(n_high >= THR), sum(n_high == K)),
                      null_mean = rowMeans(null_n), null_95 = apply(null_n, 1, quantile, 0.95),
                      p = c((1 + sum(null_n["most", ] >= sum(n_high >= THR))) / (1 + NPERM),
                            (1 + sum(null_n["all", ] >= sum(n_high == K))) / (1 + NPERM)))
} else { THR <- NA; n_high <- rep(NA_real_, length(samp)); high_test <- tibble() }

## which animals express the mfp genes: two normals with a common SD on mean mfp VST (EM), against one by BIC
mix2 <- function(x, iter = 5000, tol = 1e-12) {
  m <- unname(quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75))); s <- sd(x); p <- 0.5; ll_old <- -Inf; done <- FALSE
  post <- function() { lo <- p * dnorm(x, m[1], s); hi <- (1 - p) * dnorm(x, m[2], s); hi / (lo + hi) }
  for (i in seq_len(iter)) {
    w <- post()                                  # posterior of the upper component
    p <- mean(1 - w); m <- c(sum((1 - w) * x) / sum(1 - w), sum(w * x) / sum(w))
    s <- sqrt(sum((1 - w) * (x - m[1])^2 + w * (x - m[2])^2) / length(x))
    ll <- sum(log(p * dnorm(x, m[1], s) + (1 - p) * dnorm(x, m[2], s)))
    if (ll - ll_old < tol) { done <- TRUE; break }; ll_old <- ll
  }
  ll1 <- sum(dnorm(x, mean(x), sqrt(mean((x - mean(x))^2)), log = TRUE))
  list(mean_off = m[1], mean_on = m[2], sd = s, share_off = p, posterior_on = post(), converged = done,
       cut = (m[1] + m[2]) / 2 + s^2 * log(p / (1 - p)) / (m[2] - m[1]),        # where the two posteriors are equal
       delta_bic = (-2 * ll1 + 2 * log(length(x))) - (-2 * ll + 4 * log(length(x))))
}
if (HAS_MFP) {
  mix <- mix2(colMeans(V[mfp_genes, samp, drop = FALSE]))
  warn_unless(mix$converged, "The two-component mixture did not converge.")
  on_tab <- table(arm, factor(mix$posterior_on > 0.5, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))
  on_test <- tibble(test = c("two normals against one on mean mfp VST (delta BIC; above 10 very strong)",
                             sprintf("animals expressing the mfp genes (posterior > 0.5): %s",
                                     paste(sprintf("%s %d of %d", levels(arm), on_tab[, "TRUE"], rowSums(on_tab)), collapse = ", ")),
                             "share of animals expressing the mfp genes differs between arms (Fisher exact test)"),
                    statistic = c("delta BIC", "count", "Fisher p"),
                    value = c(mix$delta_bic, sum(mix$posterior_on > 0.5), NA),
                    p = c(NA, NA, fisher.test(on_tab)$p.value))
  cat(sprintf("mixture: components at VST %.2f and %.2f (common SD %.2f), cut %.2f; delta BIC %.1f\n",
              mix$mean_off, mix$mean_on, mix$sd, mix$cut, mix$delta_bic))
} else { mix <- list(posterior_on = rep(NA_real_, length(samp))); on_test <- tibble() }

animals <- meta %>% select(sample, mussel, treatment) %>%
  mutate(lib_size = lib_size[sample], genes_detected = detected[sample],
         mfp_vst = if (HAS_MFP) colMeans(V[mfp_genes, sample, drop = FALSE]) else NA_real_,
         mfp_read_pct = if (HAS_MFP) 100 * colSums(cm[match(mfp_genes, gene_key(rownames(cm))), sample, drop = FALSE]) / lib_size[sample] else NA_real_,
         mfp_n_high = n_high, mfp_high = if (HAS_MFP) n_high >= THR else NA,
         mfp_on_posterior = mix$posterior_on, mfp_on = mfp_on_posterior > 0.5) %>%
  bind_cols(as_tibble(scores) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("score_", .x)))
if (HAS_MFP) {
  print(knitr::kable(high_test))
  print(knitr::kable(on_test))
  print(knitr::kable(animals %>% filter(mfp_high | mfp_on) %>% arrange(treatment, desc(mfp_vst)) %>%
                       transmute(treatment, mussel, mfp_vst = round(mfp_vst, 2), mfp_on_posterior = round(mfp_on_posterior, 3), mfp_on,
                                 mfp_n_high = sprintf("%d of %d", mfp_n_high, K), mfp_high)))
}
```

# What the state goes with

```{r goes-with}
## group scores against each other (Spearman, within-arm z-scores)
gcor <- cor(scores, method = "spearman")
gcor_long <- as_tibble(gcor, rownames = "group_a") %>% pivot_longer(-group_a, names_to = "group_b", values_to = "rho") %>%
  mutate(group_a = GROUPS[group_a], group_b = GROUPS[group_b])
## threads made in the 3 days, and day-3 thread mechanics with the baseline (script 01's manifest)
thr <- read_excel(f_in[["threads"]], sheet = "data", na = "NA") %>%
  filter(days_in_trt == 3) %>% transmute(mussel = mussel_ID, threads = thread_count_after)
paired <- read_csv(f_in[["paired"]], show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(sample, mean_force, pad_area, base_mean_force, base_pad_area)
pca <- read_csv(f_in[["pca"]], show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(set == sprintf("%s | every arm", TISSUE)) %>% select(sample, pca_pc1 = PC1)
## RNA yield of each library's isolation (ng), through 05's crosswalk to the isolation log
yld <- read_csv(f_in[["xwalk"]], show_col_types = FALSE) %>% select(sample = sample.1, iso = isolation_log_sample) %>%
  left_join(read_csv(f_in[["rna_log"]], show_col_types = FALSE) %>% select(iso = sample, rna_yield_ng = `yield(ng)`), by = "iso") %>%
  select(sample, rna_yield_ng)
animals <- animals %>% left_join(thr, by = "mussel") %>% left_join(paired, by = "sample") %>% left_join(pca, by = "sample") %>%
  left_join(yld, by = "sample")
stopifnot("a join changed the animals" = identical(animals$sample, samp))
warn_unless(mean(!is.na(animals$threads)) >= 0.9, "Threads made are missing for more than a tenth of the animals.")
warn_unless(!anyNA(animals$rna_yield_ng), "An animal has no RNA yield in the isolation log.")
tech <- tibble(measure = c("library size", "genes detected", "PC1 of the day-3 PCA (05 step 14)"),
               rho = if (HAS_MFP) c(cor(animals$mfp_vst, animals$lib_size, method = "spearman"),
                                    cor(animals$mfp_vst, animals$genes_detected, method = "spearman"),
                                    abs(cor(animals$mfp_vst, animals$pca_pc1, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))) else NA_real_)
mfp_tests <- if (HAS_MFP) {
  d <- animals %>% mutate(score = score_mfp)
  fit <- function(f, data, label) {
    m <- lm(f, data = data); co <- summary(m)$coefficients; t <- co["score", "t value"]
    tibble(response = label, n = nobs(m), slope = co["score", "Estimate"], se = co["score", "Std. Error"],
           partial_r = t / sqrt(t^2 + m$df.residual), p = co["score", "Pr(>|t|)"])
  }
  bind_rows(fit(log1p(threads) ~ score + treatment, d, "threads made in the 3 days (log 1 + n)"),
            fit(log(mean_force) ~ score + treatment + log(base_mean_force), d, "day-3 mean peak force (log), baseline adjusted"),
            fit(log(pad_area) ~ score + treatment + log(base_pad_area), d, "day-3 plaque area (log), baseline adjusted"),
            fit(log(rna_yield_ng) ~ score + treatment, d, "RNA yield of the isolation (log ng), technical check"))
} else tibble()
knitr::kable(tech %>% mutate(rho = round(rho, 3)))
if (HAS_MFP) knitr::kable(mfp_tests %>% mutate(across(c(slope, se, partial_r), ~ round(.x, 3)), p = signif(p, 2)))
knitr::kable(round(gcor, 2))
```

# Beyond the byssal genes

```{r genome, fig.height = 6.5}
## every other gene against the mfp score within arms: VST ~ score + arm, from the residuals of both on arm
## (the partial correlation; t on n - arms - 1 df, as lm gives), BH q over the genes tested
if (HAS_MFP) {
  cnt_d3 <- as.matrix(cm[, samp]); rownames(cnt_d3) <- gene_key(rownames(cnt_d3))
  mt_keys <- gene_key(read.csv(f_in[["mtl"]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)$gene)
  tested <- rownames(cnt_d3)[rowSums(cnt_d3 >= 10) >= length(samp) / 3 & !rownames(cnt_d3) %in% c(mt_keys, mfp_genes)]
  tested <- intersect(tested, rownames(V))
  centre <- function(M) { for (i in idx_by_arm) M[, i] <- M[, i] - rowMeans(M[, i, drop = FALSE]); M }
  Yr <- centre(V[tested, samp, drop = FALSE]); sr <- centre(matrix(animals$score_mfp, nrow = 1))[1, ]
  df_res <- length(samp) - nlevels(arm) - 1
  r <- as.vector(Yr %*% sr) / sqrt(rowSums(Yr^2) * sum(sr^2))
  p <- 2 * pt(-abs(r * sqrt(df_res / (1 - r^2))), df_res)
  chk_i <- order(p)[c(1, 100, 5000)]
  p_lm <- vapply(chk_i, function(k) summary(lm(V[tested[k], samp] ~ animals$score_mfp + arm))$coefficients[2, 4], 0)
  warn_unless(max(abs(p_lm - p[chk_i]) / p[chk_i]) < 1e-6, "The partial correlations' p differ from lm's.")
  ann <- read_delim(f_in[["annot"]], delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(LOC_ID = gene_key(as.character(gene)), bitscore = as.numeric(bitscore)) %>% filter(!is.na(LOC_ID)) %>%
    arrange(desc(bitscore)) %>% distinct(LOC_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)            # best hit per gene, ties in table order
  genome <- tibble(LOC_ID = tested, partial_r = r, slope = as.vector(Yr %*% sr) / sum(sr^2), p = p, q = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>%
    left_join(ann %>% select(LOC_ID, protein_name = `Protein.names`), by = "LOC_ID") %>%
    left_join(byss %>% select(LOC_ID, byssal_group = group), by = "LOC_ID") %>%
    mutate(byssal_group = GROUPS[byssal_group]) %>% arrange(p)
  stopifnot(nrow(genome) == length(tested), !anyDuplicated(genome$LOC_ID))
  sig <- genome %>% filter(q < 0.05)
  genome_summary <- tibble(direction = c("with the mfp score", "against it"),
                           genes_q05 = c(sum(sig$partial_r > 0), sum(sig$partial_r < 0)),
                           of_which_byssal = c(sum(sig$partial_r > 0 & !is.na(sig$byssal_group)), sum(sig$partial_r < 0 & !is.na(sig$byssal_group))),
                           unannotated = c(sum(sig$partial_r > 0 & is.na(sig$protein_name)), sum(sig$partial_r < 0 & is.na(sig$protein_name))))
  cat(sprintf("genes tested: %d (%d df); q < 0.05: %d\n", length(tested), df_res, nrow(sig)))
  print(knitr::kable(genome_summary))
  print(knitr::kable(genome %>% filter(partial_r > 0) %>% head(25) %>%
                       transmute(LOC_ID, protein = short_name(protein_name, 45), byssal_group, partial_r = round(partial_r, 2), q = signif(q, 2))))
  print(knitr::kable(genome %>% filter(partial_r < 0) %>% head(10) %>%
                       transmute(LOC_ID, protein = short_name(protein_name, 45), byssal_group, partial_r = round(partial_r, 2), q = signif(q, 2))))
  ## figure: A, every gene tested, byssal genes ringed; B, the genes at q < 0.05 by name (the 15 smallest p if none)
  gd <- genome %>% mutate(dir = case_when(q >= 0.05 ~ "ns", partial_r > 0 ~ "up", TRUE ~ "down"), byssal = !is.na(byssal_group))
  pA_gen <- ggplot(gd, aes(partial_r, -log10(p))) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = dir), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = gd %>% filter(byssal), aes(shape = "script 04's byssal genes"), colour = "grey10", size = 1.9, stroke = 0.45) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = DIRECTION_COLORS, breaks = c("up", "down", "ns"),
                        labels = c(up = "rises with the mfp score (q < 0.05)", down = "falls (q < 0.05)", ns = "q >= 0.05"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("script 04's byssal genes" = 1), name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1)), shape = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
    labs(x = "Partial correlation with the mfp score, within arms", y = "-log10 p", title = "A. Every gene tested") +
    theme_psmfc(9.5) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical", plot.title.position = "plot")
  top_g <- if (nrow(sig)) sig %>% head(30) else genome %>% head(15)
  top_g <- top_g %>% mutate(kind = case_when(!is.na(byssal_group) ~ "byssal gene (script 04)", is.na(protein_name) ~ "no BLAST hit",
                                             TRUE ~ "other annotated gene"),
                            kind = factor(kind, levels = c("byssal gene (script 04)", "other annotated gene", "no BLAST hit")),
                            lab = paste0(ifelse(is.na(protein_name), "no hit", short_name(protein_name, 32)), " (", sub("^LOC134", "", LOC_ID), ")"),
                            lab = factor(lab, levels = rev(unique(lab))))
  pB_gen <- ggplot(top_g, aes(partial_r, lab)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = partial_r, yend = lab), colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = kind), shape = 21, size = 2.3, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.35) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("byssal gene (script 04)" = "grey15", "other annotated gene" = "grey60", "no BLAST hit" = "white"),
                      drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(0, top_g$partial_r), 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
    labs(x = "Partial correlation with the mfp score", y = NULL,
         title = if (nrow(sig)) sprintf("B. The %s genes at q < 0.05%s", nrow(sig), if (nrow(sig) > 30) " (the 30 with the smallest p)" else "")
                 else "B. No gene at q < 0.05: the 15 with the smallest p") +
    theme_psmfc(9.5) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical", plot.title.position = "plot",
                             axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5))
  p_gen <- (pA_gen | pB_gen) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.05)) +
    plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s: which other genes rise and fall with the mfp genes, within arms (VST ~ score + arm)", TISSUE_LABELS[[TISSUE]]),
                    subtitle = sprintf("%d nuclear genes (at least 10 counts in a third of the %d animals; the %d mfp genes of the score left out): %d rise, %d fall at q < 0.05 (BH)",
                                       length(tested), length(samp), K, genome_summary$genes_q05[1], genome_summary$genes_q05[2]),
                    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9)))
  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("byssal_mfp_genome_%s.png", TISSUE)), p_gen, width = 12, height = 6.8, dpi = 220, bg = "white")
  p_gen
} else cat("Fewer than 3 expressed mfp genes: no genome-wide test.\n")
```

# Heatmaps

```{r heatmaps, fig.height = 14}
## the animals in a fixed order, the same in every panel and in both figures of an order:
## by mussel ID within arm, or by mean mfp expression within arm, highest first
order_key <- if (HAS_MFP) animals$mfp_vst else colMeans(V[genes_of("core") %>% union(genes_of("other")), samp, drop = FALSE])
key_name  <- if (HAS_MFP) "mean mfp expression" else "mean byssal structural expression"
orders <- list(by_id  = animals$sample[order(animals$treatment, animals$mussel)],
               by_mfp = animals$sample[order(animals$treatment, -order_key)])
arm_lab <- c(control = "Control", OA = "OA", OW = "OW", DO = "DO")
fill_vst <- scale_fill_gradient(low = EXPRESSION_COLORS[["low"]], high = EXPRESSION_COLORS[["high"]],
                                limits = range(Vd), name = "Expression\n(VST, log2)")
heatmap <- function(genes, ord, title) {
  g <- byss %>% filter(LOC_ID %in% genes) %>% mutate(group = factor(GROUPS[group], levels = GROUPS)) %>% arrange(group, protein_name, LOC_ID)
  d <- as_tibble(Vd[g$LOC_ID, ord, drop = FALSE], rownames = "LOC_ID") %>% pivot_longer(-LOC_ID, names_to = "sample", values_to = "vst") %>%
    left_join(g %>% select(LOC_ID, group, label), by = "LOC_ID") %>%
    left_join(animals %>% select(sample, mussel, treatment), by = "sample") %>%
    mutate(mussel = factor(mussel, levels = animals$mussel[match(ord, animals$sample)]),
           label = factor(label, levels = rev(g$label)), treatment = factor(treatment, levels = ARMS))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(mussel, label, fill = vst)) + geom_tile() +
    facet_grid(group ~ treatment, scales = "free", space = "free", labeller = labeller(treatment = arm_lab, group = label_wrap_gen(14))) +
    fill_vst + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_psmfc(8) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6.5),
                           axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5), panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(3, "pt"),
                           strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, size = 7), strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"))
  if (HAS_MFP) {                                 # how many of the expressed mfp genes put the animal in its arm's top third
    a <- animals %>% filter(sample %in% ord) %>%
      mutate(mussel = factor(mussel, levels = animals$mussel[match(ord, animals$sample)]), treatment = factor(treatment, levels = ARMS))
    top <- ggplot(a, aes(mussel, "mfp genes in\nthe arm's top third")) +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = mfp_n_high), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_tile(data = a %>% filter(mfp_on), fill = NA, colour = "grey5", linewidth = 0.7, width = 0.84, height = 0.78) +
      geom_text(aes(label = mfp_n_high, colour = mfp_n_high > K / 2), size = 2.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
      facet_grid(. ~ treatment, scales = "free", space = "free", labeller = labeller(treatment = arm_lab)) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f2f2f2", high = "#5a5a5a", limits = c(0, K), name = sprintf("mfp genes\nin top third\n(of %d)", K)) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "grey20")) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_psmfc(8) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5),
            panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(3, "pt"), strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"))
    p <- (top / (p + theme(strip.text.x = element_blank()))) + plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, nrow(g)), guides = "collect")
  }
  p + plot_annotation(title = title, caption = paste0(
    "Day-3 animals; columns ", if (identical(ord, orders$by_id)) "by mussel ID within each arm" else paste("by", key_name, "within each arm, highest first"),
    ", in the same order in every panel. Script 04's VST.\nRow labels: protein (last digits of the LOC ID); + below script 04's expression filter; * hit below 40% identity.",
    if (HAS_MFP) sprintf("\nTop row: of the %d expressed mfp genes, how many put the animal in its arm's top third; outlined: the animals that express the mfp genes (two-component mixture, posterior > 0.5).", K) else ""),
    theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 7.5), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)))
}
structural <- byss$LOC_ID[byss$group %in% c("mfp", "core", "other")]
for (o in names(orders)) {
  n_s <- length(structural); n_a <- nrow(byss)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("byssal_heatmap_structural_%s_%s.png", o, TISSUE)),
         heatmap(structural, orders[[o]], sprintf("%s: byssal structural genes, every day-3 animal", TISSUE_LABELS[[TISSUE]])),
         width = 12.5, height = 2.6 + 0.12 * n_s, dpi = 220, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("byssal_heatmap_all_%s_%s.png", o, TISSUE)),
         heatmap(byss$LOC_ID, orders[[o]], sprintf("%s: every byssal and foot gene of script 04, every day-3 animal", TISSUE_LABELS[[TISSUE]])),
         width = 12.5, height = 2.6 + 0.1 * n_a, dpi = 200, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
}
heatmap(structural, orders$by_id, sprintf("%s: byssal structural genes, by mussel ID", TISSUE_LABELS[[TISSUE]]))
```

# Summary figure

```{r summary-figure, fig.height = 9}
arm_shapes <- c(control = 21, OA = 22, OW = 24, DO = 23, LC = 21)
pB <- ggplot(coord, aes(mean_r, factor(group, levels = rev(GROUPS)))) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = null_95), width = 0, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 2.5, orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = p < 0.05), shape = 21, size = 2.8, colour = "grey15") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey20", `FALSE` = "white"), labels = c(`TRUE` = "p < 0.05", `FALSE` = "p >= 0.05"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Mean correlation between the group's genes, within arms", y = NULL,
       title = "B. Do a group's genes rise and fall together in the same animals?",
       subtitle = paste0(sprintf("Grey bar: up to the 95th percentile of %d within-arm permutations", NPERM),
                         if (HAS_MFP) sprintf("\nIn the top third of their arm for all %d mfp genes: %d animals (%.1f expected)",
                                              K, high_test$observed[2], high_test$null_mean[2]) else "")) +
  theme_psmfc(9) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title.position = "plot")
pC <- ggplot(gcor_long %>% mutate(group_a = factor(group_a, levels = GROUPS), group_b = factor(group_b, levels = rev(GROUPS))),
             aes(group_a, group_b, fill = rho)) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 2.4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = DIRECTION_COLORS[["down"]], mid = "white", high = DIRECTION_COLORS[["up"]], limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Spearman") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "C. Do the same animals stand out in each group?", subtitle = "Group scores (within-arm z), Spearman") +
  theme_psmfc(9) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank(), plot.title.position = "plot")
if (HAS_MFP) {
  ref <- tibble(sample = lc, group = "LC", mfp_vst = colMeans(V[mfp_genes, lc, drop = FALSE]))
  a <- bind_rows(animals %>% transmute(sample, mussel, group = as.character(treatment), mfp_vst, mfp_on), ref %>% mutate(mfp_on = FALSE))
  a$group <- factor(a$group, levels = c(ARMS, "LC"), labels = c(arm_lab, "Lab control\n(day 0)"))
  set.seed(1); a$x <- as.numeric(a$group) + runif(nrow(a), -0.12, 0.12)   # one jitter for points and labels
  pA <- ggplot(a, aes(x, mfp_vst)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = as.numeric(group), group = group), outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, colour = "grey55") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mix$cut, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = group, shape = group), size = 2.2, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.3) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = a %>% filter(mfp_on), aes(label = mussel), size = 2.4, colour = "grey20",
                             min.segment.length = 0, seed = 2, box.padding = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(a$group)), labels = levels(a$group)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c(TREATMENT_COLORS[ARMS], THREAD_TRT_COLORS[["lab_control"]]), levels(a$group)), guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(unname(arm_shapes), levels(a$group)), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = sprintf("Mean expression of the %d expressed mfp genes (VST)", K),
         title = "A. Which mussels express the mfp genes?",
         subtitle = sprintf("Labelled: above the dashed line, %d of %d animals (two normals, not one:\ndelta BIC %.0f); the share does not differ between arms (Fisher p %.2f)",
                            sum(animals$mfp_on), length(samp), mix$delta_bic, on_test$p[3])) +
    theme_psmfc(9) + theme(plot.title.position = "plot")
  pD <- ggplot(animals %>% filter(!is.na(threads)), aes(threads, score_mfp)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = treatment, shape = treatment), size = 2.2, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = TREATMENT_COLORS, labels = arm_lab, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = arm_shapes[ARMS], labels = arm_lab, name = NULL) +
    labs(x = "Threads made in the 3 days", y = "mfp score (within-arm z)", title = "D. Do mussels with a high mfp score make more threads?",
         subtitle = with(mfp_tests[1, ], sprintf("log(1 + threads) ~ score + arm: partial r %.2f, p %s", partial_r, formatC(p, format = "fg", digits = 2)))) +
    theme_psmfc(9) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title.position = "plot")
  ## wrap_elements: D is not aligned with C's long axis labels (patchwork::free() fails with ggplot2 4)
  p_sum <- (pA | pB) / (pC | wrap_elements(full = pD)) +
    plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s: byssal gene expression by individual, within arms", TISSUE_LABELS[[TISSUE]]))
} else {
  p_sum <- (pB | pC) + plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s: byssal gene expression by individual, within arms (fewer than 3 expressed mfp genes: no mfp tests)", TISSUE_LABELS[[TISSUE]]))
}
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("byssal_individuals_%s.png", TISSUE)), p_sum, width = 13, height = if (HAS_MFP) 10 else 5.5, dpi = 220, bg = "white")
p_sum
```

```{r write}
write_csv(animals %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 4))), file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("byssal_animals_%s.csv", TISSUE)))
write_csv(coord, file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("byssal_coordination_%s.csv", TISSUE)))
write_csv(gcor_long, file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("byssal_group_correlations_%s.csv", TISSUE)))
if (HAS_MFP) {
  write_csv(genome %>% mutate(across(c(partial_r, slope), ~ round(.x, 4))), file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("byssal_mfp_genome_%s.csv", TISSUE)))
  write_csv(bind_rows(high_test %>% transmute(test, statistic = "count", value = observed, null_mean, null_95, p),
                      on_test,
                      tech %>% transmute(test = paste("mfp mean expression vs", measure), statistic = "Spearman rho", value = rho),
                      mfp_tests %>% transmute(test = paste("mfp score vs", response), statistic = "partial r", value = partial_r, n, slope, se, p)),
            file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("byssal_mfp_tests_%s.csv", TISSUE)))
} else {
  write_csv(tibble(test = sprintf("not tested: %d expressed mfp gene(s), fewer than 3", K)), file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("byssal_mfp_tests_%s.csv", TISSUE)))
}

  paste0("coordination         : ", paste(sprintf("%s r %.2f (p %s)", coord$group, coord$mean_r, signif(coord$p, 2)), collapse = "; ")),
  paste0("mfp-high animals     : ", if (HAS_MFP) sprintf("%d of %d (top third of the arm for >= %d of %d expressed mfp genes; %.1f expected, p %s); high for all %d: %d (%.1f expected, p %s); by arm: %s",
                                                        high_test$observed[1], length(samp), THR, K, high_test$null_mean[1], signif(high_test$p[1], 2),
                                                        K, high_test$observed[2], high_test$null_mean[2], signif(high_test$p[2], 2),

                                                                transmute(x = sprintf("%s %s", treatment, m)) %>% pull(x), collapse = "; ")) else "not tested (fewer than 3 expressed mfp genes)"),
  paste0("mfp-on animals       : ", if (HAS_MFP) sprintf("%d of %d (two normals with a common SD on mean mfp VST, at %.2f and %.2f, SD %.2f; cut %.2f; delta BIC %.1f); by arm: %s; arms differ: Fisher p %s",
                                                        sum(animals$mfp_on), length(samp), mix$mean_off, mix$mean_on, mix$sd, mix$cut, mix$delta_bic,
                                                        paste(animals %>% filter(mfp_on) %>% group_by(treatment) %>% summarise(m = paste(mussel, collapse = " "), .groups = "drop") %>%
                                                                transmute(x = sprintf("%s %s", treatment, m)) %>% pull(x), collapse = "; "),
                                                        signif(on_test$p[3], 2)) else "not tested"),
  paste0("mfp share of reads   : ", if (HAS_MFP) with(animals, sprintf("median %.2f%% (up to %.2f%%) in the mfp-on animals, %.2f%% (up to %.2f%%) in the others",
                                                                    median(mfp_read_pct[mfp_on]), max(mfp_read_pct[mfp_on]),
                                                                    median(mfp_read_pct[!mfp_on]), max(mfp_read_pct[!mfp_on]))) else "not computed"),
  paste0("mfp vs library       : ", if (HAS_MFP) paste(sprintf("%s rho %.2f", tech$measure, tech$rho), collapse = "; ") else "not tested"),
  paste0("mfp score vs         : ", if (HAS_MFP) paste(sprintf("%s partial r %.2f (p %s)", mfp_tests$response, mfp_tests$partial_r, signif(mfp_tests$p, 2)), collapse = "; ") else "not tested"),
  paste0("genome-wide          : ", if (HAS_MFP) sprintf("%d genes tested against the mfp score within arms; q < 0.05: %d rise (%d of them byssal), %d fall (%d byssal)",
                                                        length(tested), genome_summary$genes_q05[1], genome_summary$of_which_byssal[1],
                                                        genome_summary$genes_q05[2], genome_summary$of_which_byssal[2]) else "not tested"),
  paste0("permutations         : ", NPERM, " within arms, seed ", SEED))

            file.path(repo_root, "tools", c("pipeline_checks.R", "plot_style.R", "gene_ids.R")))
writeLines(provenance_lines(settings, inputs, repo_root, packages = c("DESeq2", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "ggrepel", "readxl")), prov)
```
